name: Prof. Dadan Hindayana
title: Head of the National Nutrition Agency (BGN)
bio: Prof. Dadan Hindayana leads the newly established National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional), executing President Prabowo's flagship Makan Bergizi Gratis program. His mission encompasses orchestrating nutritional logistics, local agricultural supply chains, and sanitized school meal kitchens across 38 provinces to eradicate childhood stunting.
